engineChanges.summary: Added an AX-backed native ordered listitem contract for decimal ol > li items whose direct block children are paragraphs and optional lists. These listitems now emit a standalone decimal marker stop, descend into body content, and suppress inherited list position on direct paragraph children and nested list summaries.
guards: native li inside native ol only
AX listitem is unnamed and not focusable
first AX child is a decimal ListMarker
saved marker metadata is normal decimal inline/inline-block
no nav ancestor, marker-separated link list, aria name, role override, controls, hidden/disabled/live, focusable listitem, or named/focusable listitem
direct visible children are p and/or list, with at least one p
AX content children after the marker are paragraph and/or list, with at least one paragraph

engineChanges.summary: Added an AX-backed native ordered direct-text contract that keeps decimal markers stitched to StaticText listitem text, including direct inline links, and a direct-text plus nested-list variant that keeps the parent item stitched while allowing traversal into the nested list.
guards: native li inside native ol only
AX listitem is unnamed and not focusable
first AX child is a decimal ListMarker followed by StaticText matching direct leading text
direct semantic children are either direct links or direct nested lists, never both
direct links must match AX link DOM ids and focusability
direct nested list variant appends parent position metadata and descends only into the nested list
